## Debugger support

| Call | Purpose | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **F$DFork** | Fork suspended debuggee | F$Fork inputs plus (a2)=register buffer -> child PID + initial register image. Child never runs until F$DExec; the image shows SR with the trace bit set. `Live` (os9exec) |
| **F$DExec** | Drive debuggee | d0.w=PID, d1.l=instruction count (0=free run), d2.w=breakpoint count, (a0)=breakpoint list -> instructions executed, remaining count, exception offset/classification/access address/IR. Syscalls (including through trap handlers and F$Chain) run at ful
